scripts.frontend:stop: pids=$(pgrep -f 'vite/bin/vite.js' || true); for p in $pids; do [ "$p" = "$$" ] && continue; [ "$p" = "$PPID" ] && continue; kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
scripts.services:stop: pids=$(pgrep -f 'uvicorn app.main:app.*8001' || true); for p in $pids; do [ "$p" = "$$" ] && continue; [ "$p" = "$PPID" ] && continue; kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
